title: B02 2025H1 Breakout Failure Recovery Study
purpose: Preserve the profitable 2023-2024 B02 architecture, decompose the known 2025H1 B02 loss, and change B02 only if a finite portable recovery rule improves EA-wide economics without material historical winner damage.

baseline_contract.signal: completed M15 close outside 00:00-07:00 UTC same-day session range during 07:00-12:59 UTC
baseline_contract.entry: first executable Tick at next M15 boundary; Long Ask, Short Bid
baseline_contract.exit: first executable Tick after 48 M15 bars; Long Bid, Short Ask

failure_decomposition.common_observation_contract: first executable M15-boundary Bid; Short executable Ask equals Bid plus frozen five-point spread
failure_decomposition.intrabar_5s_15s_1m_5m_policy: report only where source-native observations exist; otherwise mark unavailable rather than infer exact Tick outcomes
failure_decomposition.priority_order: mutually exclusive first-match classification using immediate failure, slow failure, giveback, exhaustion, horizon, session/volatility, overlap, other

candidate_catalog.rule: At the first executable boundary Tick 30 minutes after Entry, close if executable gross pips are not positive; otherwise retain the original 48-bar lifecycle.
candidate_catalog.parameters: single frozen window; no threshold grid; no side/session exception

candidate_catalog.rule: From the first completed M15 boundary after Entry, close on the first executable Tick at which Long Bid is at or below the frozen session high, or Short Ask is at or above the frozen session low.
candidate_catalog.parameters: Entry-time range boundary only; no fixed SL, ATR multiplier, side/session exception or month filter

candidate_catalog.rule: After at least one completed M15 boundary has positive executable gross pips, close at the first later completed M15 boundary whose executable gross pips are non-positive.
candidate_catalog.parameters: online state only; no future peak, trailing grid, target-specific exit, side/session exception or month filter

core_mt4_policy: Implement only an adopted candidate; require zero Research/Core and Core/MT4 mismatch, JPY accounting, standalone and F05-integrated tester, full-equity and margin evidence.
prohibited: modification of HYP039 HYP040 HYP041 or portfolio integration branches/statuses
